summary: Standing rule: the dispatch session fast-forwards the parent checkout to origin/main (git pull --ff-only, clean tree only) and rebuilds pipeline-cli dist (nvm 22.23.2, pnpm --filter @ai-sdlc/pipeline-cli build) after every main landing; this is NOT touching main (no commit, no push) and is on the dispatch operational list. Refresh of the plugin cache is included.

options.description: dispatch does the ff-only pull + dist rebuild + plugin cache refresh as part of its tick; refuses on a dirty tree and escalates
dispatch never pulls; planner or operator does it by hand each landing (status quo; blocks cli-ci sweep whenever main moves)
